name: llamafile
description_en: Distribute and run LLMs with a single file.
readme_excerpt: llamafile llamafile lets you distribute and run LLMs with a single file. llamafile is a Mozilla Builders project (see its announcement blog post), now revamped by Mozilla.ai. Our goal is to make open LLMs much more accessible to both developers and end users.
